nodes.label: Web UI
nodes.summary: React SPA (Vite) where the user picks projects, chats with Claude, approves tool calls and navigates the code maps.

nodes.label: App Shell
nodes.summary: Sidebar with project selection, add/new project forms and chat list, switching between chat, map and rules screens.

nodes.label: Chat View
nodes.summary: One chat's live feed (replayed then streamed over SSE), approval cards, composer, mode/model controls and the map pane with read/edit heat.

nodes.label: Map Screen
nodes.summary: Shows a project's architecture, data-model and flows maps, polls generation jobs, marks stale nodes and hands nodes to a chat.

nodes.label: Map Canvas
nodes.summary: React Flow + ELK diagram of one map level with drill-down and stale/selected/context/heat markers.

nodes.label: File Viewer
nodes.summary: Read-only modal showing a project file with line numbers or a folder's entries.

nodes.label: Project Settings
nodes.summary: Edits a project's default Discuss/Build models and its allow/ask/deny approval rules.

nodes.label: API Client
nodes.summary: Thin typed fetch client that parses every API response with the shared Zod contracts.

nodes.label: Flightdeck Server
nodes.summary: Hono Node server that serves the SPA, the JSON API, chat SSE streams and Claude Code's PreToolUse hook endpoints.

nodes.label: HTTP Routes
nodes.summary: Route table for projects, new-project scaffolding, maps, files, rules, chats, approvals, the SSE feed, hooks and static files.

nodes.label: Gateway Listener
nodes.summary: Second listener on the docker0 address that only accepts requests carrying the gateway secret header and never serves /hook.

nodes.label: Chat Runner
nodes.summary: Runs each chat turn as a headless `claude -p` process, streams its JSON events into the feed and records the run.

nodes.label: Approval Hook
nodes.summary: Decides every tool call of a chat: Discuss-mode refusal, per-project edit lock, project rules, else an approval card held until the user clicks.

nodes.label: Rules Engine
nodes.summary: Pure matcher for Claude Code-style rule patterns into allow/ask/deny with Deny > Ask > Allow precedence, plus template rules and pattern suggestions.

nodes.label: Map Generator
nodes.summary: Spawns a read-only `claude -p` agent with a JSON schema to produce a map, validates it, writes it into the repo and computes staleness from git.

nodes.label: Chat Feed
nodes.summary: Append-only per-chat event log with in-memory subscribers for live SSE delivery and full replay.

nodes.label: File Access
nodes.summary: Read-only viewing of files and folders inside a project, refusing paths outside it or in .git.

nodes.label: DB Access
nodes.summary: Drizzle schema plus boot-time DDL/column upgrades over SQLite, closing out runs and approvals left open by a restart.

nodes.label: Shared Contracts
nodes.summary: Zod schemas and types for everything crossing the wire, plus the stack catalogue used to scaffold new projects.

nodes.label: Wire Contracts
nodes.summary: Projects, chats, rules, feed items, Claude stream events, hook payloads and map schemas shared by server and UI.

nodes.label: Stack Catalogue
nodes.summary: Stacks offered for a new project and the scaffold prompt that sends their instruction to a Build chat.

nodes.label: SQLite Database
nodes.summary: flightdeck.db (WAL) holding projects, rules, chats, runs and the approvals audit trail.

nodes.label: Chat Feed Files
nodes.summary: One JSONL file per chat under the data directory, the durable replay of everything shown in the chat.

nodes.label: Project Repositories
nodes.summary: The user's git repos on disk: worked on by Claude, read via git for change detection, and holding generated maps in .flightdeck/.

nodes.label: Claude Code CLI
nodes.summary: The unmodified `claude` CLI on the subscription, spawned headless for chat turns and map generation, calling back into the hook.

nodes.label: SSO Gateway
nodes.summary: Shared nginx SSO gateway in Docker that fronts the production URL and forwards to the gateway listener with a secret header.

edges.label: spawns read-only claude -p with JSON schema
